#Introduction

With a heartbeat measured in aeons, a new tribe arose at the dark ends of the earth. Stretching ashen limbs from frigid domains, they waged war against the might of the sun and all it's heat had brought forth. Species arced and shattered like fleas and meteors peppered the earth as scions of the winterlord ground mountains to rubble under their glacial steeds and the glittering nets of his daughters stilled the teeming seas. Again they advance and again they are scoured back amid torrents of meltwater and shattered sea-ice.

So the cycle has turned for longer than any living race can remember, and so it must continue to turn until the sun finally gives up it's life, and summer fades from memory.

#Personality

The ice lord's fury is cold and intense, but so slowly moving that it may as well be static to a mortal eye. His greatest weakness is his brittle and uncompromising stubbornness, which leaves him vulnerable to those who play a more subtle game. He sees peace only in the passsive stillness of the heart of winter, and life is an unwelcome irritation.

#Aspirations

Geimhreadh wants only one thing, to spread his tribe's domain across the face of the planet, until all is ice and the only motion is the falling snow and the only sound is the screech of a blizzard.

#Domains

* Spreading ice (glaciers, pack-ice, avalanches etc.)

* Cold blooded violence (feuds, premeditated murder, especially long planned revenge, torture)

* Stasis (Long nights, winter solstics, permafrost)
